narrative: The penny almanac open at January under the candle. Your hand is at the edge of the leaf, out of the mark. A small cross sits beside the 5. The space next to the cross is blank. No second mark is being made. The cross has dried. You have not added a word, a name, or a street. The rest of that line is empty.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Made the cross and did not gloss it.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in A cross and no word
